services.name: Island Charter
services.desc: We will take you on a sea cruise along the enchanted coastal waterway or head offshore for more adventure! Bring your favorite food and beverages (BYOB) for the best time out on the water with your crew. We provide a galley fully stocked and ready to keep your items ice cold in the fridge and freezer. We also have awesome catering options to choose from as well; Caviar and Bananas, Fast and French, and Sullivan’s Board Co. Relax with a sail out to a barrier island, anchor out and enjoy the cool summer breezes while dining in the shaded spacious cockpit of Windchaser, our 50 ft luxury sailing yacht. Spread out and sunbathe on the large foredeck, enjoy lunch, swim and cool off in the ocean,

blurb: Guests sail on a 50-foot classic yacht around Charleston Harbor, seeing historic landmarks and enjoying panoramic views. Tours include sunset sails, day sails to barrier islands with opportunities to swim, and customizable private charters. The yacht has deck and cabin space with a full galley and fridge.

quotes.author: Matthew W. ☀ TripAdvisor
quotes.text: AMAZING EXPERIENCE !!! I loved every second of the sailing adventure from start to finish. Had so much fun bonding with friends on the boat while the very professional crew sailed us around and made sure we had a fun and relaxing time. Jen and Janet did a great job at making sure we got to see all the beauty of Charleston and helped us watch one of the best sunsets I’ve seen.

quotes.author: Lisa D. ☀ TripAdvisor
quotes.text: To say that our experience was perfect is an understatement! Front the awesome views to the dolphins swimming right beside us, it was a trip I will definitely be taking again! Captains Jen and Janet were amazing...professional and laid back, they made us all feel at home and totally relaxed. A must-do in Charleston!

quotes.author: Matt R. ☀ TripAdvisor
quotes.text: History, dolphins, the harbor of Charleston.... and a little wine. We really couldn’t have had a more perfect trip! The ladies Captaining the Shenanigan were very knowledgeable and made us feel safe the whole time. We plan on going again soon!

quotes.author: Emily W. ☀ TripAdvisor
quotes.text: So much fun! It was amazing! Can’t wait to go again! We saw dolphins and the most amazing views! They like to knew everything about the harbor!
